items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Connie Jones just had a little trio

ctx.x: He really plays nice solos, and I wish I could hear more of it. And he's just as sweet a guy as you ever met in your life. I used to hear him some with Connie in a trio. Connie Jones just had a little trio, and sometimes he'd use Harvey Rubin, and different piano players.
One of them was, oh, you know, Armand's brother-in-law, Armand Hugg's brother. Bob Doyle.
